summary: Many NYC streets have alternate side parking (ASP) for street cleaning; days and hours are on the signs for each block. You cannot park on the side being cleaned for the whole posted time, even after the sweeper has passed.
quote: You cannot park on the side of the street that is being cleaned when ASP rules are in effect. The rules apply for the length of the entire block, and for the entire time posted on the sign, even if the street sweeper has already passed.

summary: ASP is not in effect on Sundays, and is suspended on listed legal and religious holidays, in severe weather and in emergencies.
quote: ASP rules are suspended on certain legal and religious holidays each year, during severe weather, and for emergencies. On Sundays, ASP is not in effect

summary: The city may suspend ASP for snow or emergencies, sometimes announced late in the day; ASP is restored after a snowfall so plows can clear the curb lane. No citywide snow-route parking ban was found on the pages read.
quote: NYC may suspend ASP regulations because of inclement weather or emergencies. The decision is sometimes made late in the day since weather patterns can change fast. NYC restores ASP regulations after a snowfall.

summary: No citywide overnight street-parking ban appears on NYC DOT's parking pages; what applies is whatever the signs on the block say, and the most restrictive sign wins.
quote: If there is more than one sign posted for the same area, the more restrictive one is the one in effect. If a sign is missing on a block, the remaining posted regulations are the ones that are in effect. Please check the entire block and read all signs carefully before you park.

summary: All of NYC is a tow-away zone: a car parked illegally, or with a missing or expired registration or inspection sticker, may be towed.
quote: All of New York City is a designated Tow Away Zone under the State's Vehicle and Traffic Law. This means that any vehicle parked or operated illegally, or with missing or expired registration or inspection stickers, may be towed.

summary: Parking within 15 feet of a fire hydrant is illegal.
quote: It is illegal to park within 15 feet of either side of a fire hydrant

summary: Meters are not in effect on Sundays or on the six major legal holidays. Other hours are on the meter or sign.
quote: Metered regulations are not in effect on Sundays nor major legal holidays (New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day).

summary: Passenger meter rates outside Manhattan's core: $2.50 first hour and $5.00 second hour in business districts such as Downtown Flushing and Jamaica; $2.00 / $3.00 in neighborhood retail districts; $1.50 / $2.50 elsewhere.

summary: No resident street-parking permit program is described on NYC DOT's Motorists & Parking, Parking Regulations, Parking Meters or Municipal Parking pages; the only permits listed there are for disability, clergy, agency business and highway travel.

summary: Municipal parking fields (open lots) do not allow overnight parking; they close at the posted hour, typically 10 PM.

summary: In any public place a dog must be on a leash no longer than six feet.

summary: Parking is banned on certain posted streets whenever snow covers the roadway.

summary: Dover has an On-Street Overnight Parking Permit and a Municipal Lot Overnight Residential Parking Permit; municipal lots are closed to cars without the overnight permit from 2 AM to 6 AM.

summary: The Parking Utility page links an On-Street Overnight Parking Permit and a Municipal Lot Overnight Residential Parking Permit (forms not read; fee not on the page).

summary: General parking rate is $1.00 per hour.

summary: Garage and lot permits are sold on a semi-annual or annual basis (no monthly option stated); the rate sheet is a separate document that was not read.

summary: All dogs over 4 months must be licensed, with a rabies certificate and proof of residency. Fee: $16 spayed or neutered, $23 if not; $5 late fee.

summary: Overnight parking on city streets is allowed year-round; the old seasonal winter restriction was repealed.

summary: All dogs must be on a leash when off the owner's property. No length is stated on the page.

summary: No vehicle may be parked in a designated and announced snow alert or snow emergency area.
